mapper.insert: insert into job (id, description, source_name, db_name, odps_project, type, status, timer, config, create_time) values ( #{id}, #{description}, #{sourceName}, #{dbName}, #{dstOdpsProject}, #{type}, #{status}, #{timer, typeHandler=com.aliyun.odps.mma.util.TimerHandler}, #{config, typeHandler=com.aliyun.odps.mma.util.JobConfigHandler}, now() )
mapper.select: select id from job order by id desc limit 1;
mapper.update: update job set stopped=1 where id=#{id}
update job set restart=1 where id=#{id}
update job set stopped=0 where id=#{id}

update task set restart=1, start_time=null, stopped=0 where job_id=#{jobId} and batch_id=(select max(batch_id) from job_batch where job_id=#{jobId}) and status in ('SCHEMA_FAILED', 'DATA_FAILED', 'VERIFICATION_FAILED')

update task set restart=1, start_time=null, stopped=0 where job_id=#{jobId} and batch_id=(select max(batch_id) from job_batch where job_id=#{jobId}) and status in ('SCHEMA_DOING', 'DATA_DOING', 'VERIFICATION_DOING', 'SCHEMA_DONE', 'DATA_DONE', 'VERIFICATION_DONE')
update job set deleted=1 where id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into job_batch (job_id, batch_id, status, err_msg, create_time) values (#{jobId}, #{batchId}, #{status}, #{errMsg}, now())
mapper.update: update job set last_batch=#{batchId} where id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: select * from job where timer is not null and deleted = 0 and stopped = 0
